species.real: That scream in the night that sounds like someone being murdered is usually a vixen calling in the winter mating season. Nobody is being murdered; it just feels personal.
species.name: Binfox

dex.text: Has read every bin on the estate and is halfway through the recycling. Shows no remorse, only a fine sense of timing and a good eye for chips.
dex.fact: Foxes have vertical, slit-shaped pupils, like cats, which help them see well in dim light.
